artworks.title: Saint Prosper
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.9 x 35.2 cm (9 7/16 x 13 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a battlefield with a fortified city in the distance, against a dramatic sky filled with celestial figures. The precise brushstrokes show soldiers and cavalry charging across the landscape towards the city, with an expansive army behind them. The monochromatic color palette highlights the detailed line work and contrasts between earthly and celestial elements.

artworks.title: Fastose Aguglie e Mausolei vetusti
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows classical ruins from a distant point of view. In the center, there is an ornate structure resembling an ancient mausoleum or temple with arches and a statue. Other ruins and stone structures flank this central feature. A man sits on a fragment of a ruin, with another man leaning against an obelisk. The ruins dominate the horizon. The etching technique is detailed, creating intricate textures. The monochrome palette enhances the contrasts and timeless quality of the subject matter.

artworks.title: The Marriage of Europe and China
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and pen and black ink, with gray wash over black chalk
artworks.dimensions: overall: 33.7 x 45.7 cm (13 1/4 x 18 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures engaged in a ceremonial event. Two figures in ornate attire stand facing each other, with one extending their hand towards the other. Additional figures surround them in various poses. Sculptural elements, a palm tree, and architectural details are visible in the background. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Bouquet d'arbres aux rochers (Stand of Trees with Rocks)
artworks.medium: drypoint on oatmeal paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.2 x 25.5 cm (7 9/16 x 10 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view over a natural landscape with trees and rocky formations. The horizon is low in the upper middle of the image with open sky and a few clouds. Birds are flying in the distance. The brushstroke technique is detailed and precise, creating textured foliage and cloud formations. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia. Rocky terrain, plant life, and two small figures pointing to the landscape are depicted.

artworks.title: Head of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: metalpoint heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (approximate): 8.1 x 9.3 cm (3 3/16 x 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up view of a person's face, focusing on the head and part of the neck. The individual is in a reclined position with their head tilted back and slightly to the side. Their eyes are closed, and their facial features include a nose, slightly open mouth, and a beard. The person's hair is long and wavy, partially visible on one side. The drawing is on a blue background with white highlights and shading to depict the facial features. There is no visible clothing or jewelry, and the background is a simple, textured blue space framing the person's face. The artwork has an aged look, with slightly worn or rounded corners.

artworks.title: Edmond de Goncourt
artworks.medium: etching on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features an older man in a portrait style. He is positioned facing slightly to the side while looking directly at the viewer. The man has distinctive large eyes, a prominent mustache, and short, wavy hair with hints of greying. He wears a light-colored shirt with a loosely tied large scarf around his neck. In his hand, he holds a smoking cigarette, with smoke rising upwards. The background is elaborately detailed with decorative elements, including an artistic depiction of a figure and a small bird perched within a circular frame surrounded by leaves. The background also showcases intricate patterns and ornate woodwork.

artworks.title: Landscape with Large Rock
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 5 x 8.5 cm (1 15/16 x 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is dominated by trees and a large rock formation. Birds are in flight above the horizon. The foliage is depicted with delicate brushstrokes blending seamlessly. The color palette is warm and monochromatic brown. In the foreground, three figures and a dog are walking along a rugged path as the landscape rises towards the trees and rock formation.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This image depicts an ornately designed manuscript page. The central text block is titled "ANIMALIA RATIONALIA ET INSECTA," framed within a decorative border. The top features an intricate scroll design with various colors and an inscription in a fiery cartouche with the word "IGNIS." The corners of the frame include decorative flourishes in pink, yellow, blue, and green hues, with ribbon-like extensions and hanging accents. At the bottom, a smaller inscription reads "Qui fecit Angelos spiritus suos: Et ministros suos flammam verentem," within a blue-bordered decorative bracket with stylized elements. This style is reminiscent of illuminated manuscripts from the Renaissance or Baroque period.

artworks.title: Plate 9: Meadow Brown, Gatekeeper, Clouded Yellow, and Bath White Butterflies
artworks.medium: watercolor, lepidochromy, and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows four butterflies drawn within a large oval on a light background. The top two butterflies are in shades of brown and are positioned side by side with their wings closed. The butterfly in the bottom left has wings spread open displaying patterns in beige and brown with yellow accents, while the one on the bottom right holds its wings closed and is predominantly yellow with hints of brown and pink. The color palette includes earthy tones of brown, yellow, pink, and beige. The butterflies are placed within the oval, with two near the top and two at the bottom, providing balance to the composition.

artworks.title: Plate 10: Brown Hairstreak, Silver-Washed Fritillary, and Clouded Yellow Butterflies on a Four-o'-Clock Flower
artworks.medium: watercolor, lepidochromy,  and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 11: Small Tortoiseshell and Red Admiral Butterflies with a Mole Cricket
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features three insects inside an oval border: a butterfly with orange and black wings on the left side, a closed-wing butterfly with a predominantly blue and brown pattern on the right, and a detailed cricket-like insect with brown tones below. The color palette includes natural tones such as orange, black, brown, and blue, set against a light background. The number "XI" is labeled on the right side outside the oval.

artworks.title: Plate 12: Two Views of a Silver-Bordered Fritillary and a Mole Cricket
artworks.medium: watercolor and silver and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows two butterflies and an earwig. One butterfly is orange with black patterns and spots, while the other has a mix of orange and blue with black spots. The earwig is brown with darkened pincers, positioned to the far right. The composition is surrounded by a faint oval line, set against an off-white background.

artworks.title: Plate 13: Yellow Swallowtail and Red Admiral Butterflies with a Dragonfly (Broad-Bodied Chaser?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Three insects are depicted in the image: a butterfly with dark blue and red wings on the bottom left, a larger butterfly with white, black, and blue patterns at the top center, and a dragonfly with brown and gold tones on the bottom right. The color palette includes rich blues, reds, browns, and golds against a neutral background. The central butterfly is positioned higher than the other two insects, with the left butterfly and right dragonfly symmetrically arranged below.

artworks.title: Plate 14: Common Brimstone, Painted Lady, and Clouded Yellow Butterflies
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Three butterflies are depicted in the image, each displaying unique colors and patterns. The color palette consists of soft yellows, browns, greens, and hints of pink. The left butterfly has pale yellow wings with dark tips, the right butterfly showcases intricate brown patterns with hints of pink and blue, and a vibrant green butterfly is shown from a side view at the bottom. The butterflies are arranged in a loose triangular formation within an oval frame, with the number "XIV" visible to the right of the oval.

artworks.title: Plate 15: Grayling Butterfly, Magpie Moth, and Two Chrysalides
artworks.medium: watercolor, lepidochromy, and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows two large butterflies prominently, with one on the left and the other slightly to the right, both featuring detailed patterns on their wings. Below them, there are three smaller subjects, including two chrysalis forms in the mid-left and mid-right, and an emerging butterfly with its wings partially spread at the lower center of the image. All these elements are framed within an oval delineation, set against a plain white background.

artworks.title: Plate 16: Black-Veined White, Clouded Yellow, Black Hairstreak(?), Geranium Argus(?), and Common Blue Butterflies with Two Chrysalides
artworks.medium: watercolor, lepidochromy,  and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts an oval frame containing illustrations of butterflies and chrysalises. The largest butterflies are positioned at the top center, with one mostly white with black lines and the other yellow with a dark spot on its wing. Below them is a smaller brown and beige butterfly. Two chrysalises are on each side of the oval, and two smaller butterflies are at the bottom, one with blue and beige wings and the other with brown wings and small markings. The color palette includes beiges, browns, whites, yellows, and a hint of blue. The objects are symmetrically arranged within the oval.

artworks.title: Plate 17: Brimstone and Meadow Brown(?) Butterflies, a Blue Chaser, and Two Small Insects
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows a large dragonfly with translucent wings and a blue body in the center. It is accompanied by two butterflies - one with pale green wings on the left and another with orange-brown wings in the bottom center. There is also a small beetle in the bottom left quadrant and another small insect with red and black coloring on the right, just below the dragonfly's wings. The color palette includes shades of blue, green, orange, brown, and hints of yellow.

artworks.title: Plate 18: Two Butterflies and a Moth with a Damselfly, Two Ants, and Four Other Insects
artworks.medium: watercolor and silver and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various insects. The composition features detailed illustrations of different insects, showcasing their unique characteristics. The painting includes a variety of species such as a butterfly, dragonfly, moth, beetle, and several others, all contained within an oval frame. Each insect is labeled with a small number. The insects are painted realistically, displaying wings, coloration, and details. The inscriptions include Latin text and numerals. The overall tone is informative and aesthetically pleasing, celebrating the beauty and diversity of entomological life.

artworks.title: Plate 1: Pedro González (Petrus Gonsalvus) and His Wife, Catherine
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Set within a drawn oval frame, two people are shown from the waist up against a parchment-white background in this horizontal watercolor portrait. To the left, the man’s face is entirely covered with golden brown hair, leaving space for only the eyes, the protruding nose, and mouth. He looks at us, wearing a narrow white collar over a lapis-blue robe with black sleeves. To our right, a woman rests one hand on his near shoulder. Her body is angled toward him, to the left, and she looks off in that direction. She has a round face, pale skin, rosy cheeks, and dark pink lips. She wears a black cap with a wide, flat strip of cloth draped from front to back. Her black dress has a white ruff collar, puffed sleeves, a cinched waist, and a full skirt. The pair stand behind what appears to be a grassy ledge with a twig growing out of a rise to the left. The background behind them and beyond the gold line border is white. Latin text is handwritten above and below the gold oval frame in two colors of ink. Above and in purple, text reads, “Omni miraculo quod fit per Hominem maius miraculum est Homo visibilium omnium maximus est Mundus, invisibilium DEVS sed mundum esse cospicimus,  Deum esse Credimus…” Below and in yellow ink, text reads, ““HOMO natus de MVLIERE, brevi viventis Tempore Repletus multis miseriis. Job 14.”

artworks.title: Plate 19: Two Butterflies with Five Other Insects
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features several insects within an oval boundary. The main objects are a light-colored butterfly with pale wings in the center, a bright blue butterfly to its left, and a green beetle to its right. The color palette includes vibrant blues, earthy browns, soft creams, bright green, and vivid yellow and black stripes on a bee-like insect. Other insects like a bee, a smaller moth, and a fly are arranged around the central butterfly, each distinctively numbered.

artworks.title: Plate 20: Three Butterflies, a Caterpillar, a Bee, Two Chrysalides, and Three Weevils
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 21: A Butterfly with a Dragonfly, a Ladybug, and Five other Insects
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 22: A Cinnabar Moth and a Cockchafer with Butterflies, other Insects, and a Snapdragon
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 23: Hummingbird Hawk Moth, Butterflies, and Other Insects around a Snowberry Sprig
artworks.medium: watercolor, lepidochromy, and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features five detailed depictions of various insects placed within an oval frame that centers around a sprig with white berries and green leaves. At the lower center is a large moth or butterfly with gray and brown wings. To its left, a smaller brown butterfly rests with its wings closed, while the bottom left showcases another small butterfly with speckled brown wings. Near the top right, another butterfly or moth is positioned with open wings, and in the bottom right, an insect with transparent wings and a dark body is illustrated. The colors in the image are primarily earthy browns, soft grays, and muted greens, with subtle touches of pink on the berries adding a hint of brightness. The position of the subjects in the illustration is deliberate, with each insect numbered and spaced around the central branch, creating a harmonious circular composition.
